title: PDF reports
description: Download a snapshot PDF or open a print-friendly page. Figures keep Actual, Committed, and Forecast labels. Invoice totals are billing/cash, not profit. VAT is not profit.
snapshotNote: This file is a snapshot at the time it was generated.
noProjects: No accessible projects to report on.
csvStillHere: Spreadsheet exports (CSV / Excel) stay in the export menu above.

kindHints.project_financial_summary: Commercial, billing, cost, and profit when permitted.
kindHints.boq_progress: Physical progress from approved quantities - not Actual cost.
kindHints.change_order_summary: Approved versus pending. Pending does not change the current contract.
kindHints.quote_estimate: Pre-sale quote. Quote is not a billing record.
kindHints.field_daily: Daily log with photo document names, not a full photo dump.
kindHints.punch_inspection: Open and closed punch items and inspections.

fields.openAp: Open AP payable (cash disclosure, not Actual)
fields.caption: Caption
fields.title: Title

notices.pendingNotInContract: Pending changes do not update the current contract until they are approved.
notices.billingNotPayment: Invoice total is billing, not payment. Paid is cash. Neither figure is profit.
notices.vatNotProfit: VAT is not profit. Profit uses net contract excluding VAT.
notices.actualCommittedForecast: Actual, Committed, and Forecast are different figures and must not be mixed.
notices.progressNotActual: BOQ physical progress is quantity complete. It is not Actual cost and not a payment.
notices.quoteNotBilling: A quote / estimate is not a billing record, not a change order, and not revenue.
notices.profitOmitted: Profit is omitted because this viewer cannot read project profit.
notices.compensationOmitted: Workforce compensation is omitted because this viewer cannot read employer cost.
notices.commercialOmitted: Commercial contract figures are omitted because this viewer cannot read contracts.
notices.photosCapped: Photo files are listed by name and caption. Binary images are not embedded in this pack.

empty.boq: No active bill of quantities on this project.
empty.changes: No change requests on this project.
empty.vendors: No vendors engaged on this project.
